text:
maya: Heads up — we saw a latency spike in us-east around 10:12. I opened a rollback PR for the connpool tweak that landed earlier: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1024
maya: Can someone take a quick look and approve for an immediate canary merge? This is blocking the canary rollout.
alex: On it, grabbing logs and will run a quick smoke replay (ETA ~8–10m).
jordan: I'll skim the diff now. If it's just the connpool defaults, we can revert and patch later.
erin: :eyes: adding perf check to replay job. tagging @oncall-rotation in case we need emergency approval.
deploy-bot: Deployment action required — PR #1024 labelled priority-high, manual approval needed to proceed to canary.
oncall-rotation: I'm on call and standing by. Once smoke passes I can grant the emergency approval.
alex: Smoke replay (1k requests) shows p95 back to baseline, no 5xx. Quick log excerpt:
```
[us-east] 2026-03-16T10:20:32Z INFO request_id=abc123 status=200 latency_ms=78
[us-east] 2026-03-16T10:20:33Z INFO kv_cache miss
```
alex: Approving PR now.
jordan: Left two tiny comments (nits) in the PR but nothing blocking. Approving as well.
maya: Thanks — merging and kicking off canary deployment. I'll watch metrics for the next 15m and report back.
maya: Canary looks stable at +15m, error rate normal, latency within baseline. Planning prod rollout in the 30m window.
jordan: Can you add a one-paragraph blurb for incidents channel after prod roll? Small postmortem to capture trigger and next steps.
maya: Yep — will draft and post to incidents and ping infra leads.
erin: Great job moving fast everyone :thumbsup:
maya: Merge/rollback done. Leaving the PR reference here for traceability: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1024
erin: Thanks all — closing the loop.
